title: Favorite Garlic Noodles
description: These garlic noodles stir-fried in a sesame-soy sauce will be a favorite side dish to serve with grilled meat or fish.

steps.text: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rapid boil. Cook egg noodles at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, 7 to 9 minutes. Drain.
Add soy sauce, peanut oil, sesame oil, and garlic to the same pot. Return egg noodles to the pan and stir until well coated.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Transfer noodles and sauce into the hot pan and stir-fry until they are slightly crispy, 3 to 5 minutes. Garnish with green onion.

video.description: In this video, we’ll show you how to make a quick and delicious garlic noodles recipe that is sure to become a favorite. This recipe is simple, with only six ingredients, and takes under 30 minutes to make from start to finish. The noodles are packed with garlicky flavor and can be easily adjusted to suit your taste preferences. They make a great side dish for grilled flank steak, but can also be enjoyed on their own. Whether you're looking for a quick and easy meal or a tasty side dish, this garlic noodles recipe is sure to become a favorite.
